values: 盘坐后对周围敌人造成伤害，之后消耗能量维持“苍竹劲”状态，在“苍竹劲”状态中自身获得攻击力和急速加成，同时解锁技能“封天掌”对单体敌人造成高额伤害并使目标不能恢复能量。

Pang focuses his chi before unleashing a powerful burst that deals damage to nearby enemies. He then enters the Unyielding Force stance, which drains Energy while active.
In Unyielding Force stance, Pang gains extra Haste and ATK and unlocks Skybreach Strikes, which deal heavy damage to a single enemy and prevent the enemy from recovering Energy.

潘撑起竹竿盘坐运行体内的真气，盘坐结束后体内真气爆发，对附近2格范围的敌人造成350% + 50% ATK的伤害，随后自身将进入“苍竹劲”状态，并且每秒需要消耗150点能量来维持该状态。本技能释放期间，潘获得霸体。 
处于“苍竹劲”状态时，潘获得60急速和17%攻击力加成，并解锁技能“封天掌”：蓄力后双掌交替拍向对方共7次，每次造成70% ATK的伤害，最后一击伤害增加至150% ATK并使目标眩晕1.5秒；在最后一击时封印其真气流动，使非首领敌人5秒内无法恢复能量。

Pang enters a meditative state, focusing his chi before unleashing a powerful burst at the end of the meditation. The burst deals 350% + 50% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles. He then enters the Unyielding Force stance, which drains 150 Energy per second while active. Pang remains unaffected while casting this skill. 
In Unyielding Force stance, Pang increases his Haste by 60 and ATK by 17%, and unlocks Skybreach Strikes.
Skybreach Strikes: Pang charges his strength, strikes an enemy 7 times with alternating palm attacks. Each strike deals 70% ATK damage. The final strike deals 150% ATK damage and stuns the enemy for 1.5s. When hitting a non-boss enemy, the final strike also prevents Energy recovery for 5s.
真气爆发的伤害提升至380% + 50% ATK，“苍竹劲”状态提供的攻击力加成提升至19%。
Increases the chi burst damage to 380% + 50% ATK, and the ATK bonus granted by Unyielding Force to 19%.
真气爆发的伤害提升至410% + 50% ATK，“苍竹劲”状态提供的攻击力加成提升至21%。
Increases the chi burst damage to 410% + 50% ATK, and the ATK bonus granted by Unyielding Force to 21%.
真气爆发的伤害提升至440% + 50% ATK，“苍竹劲”状态提供的攻击力加成提升至23%。
Increases the chi burst damage to 440% + 50% ATK, and the ATK bonus granted by Unyielding Force to 23%.
真气爆发的伤害提升至470% + 50% ATK，“苍竹劲”状态提供的攻击力加成提升至25%。
Increases the chi burst damage to 470% + 50% ATK, and the ATK bonus granted by Unyielding Force to 25%.
重击敌人造成较高伤害。
Pang strikes an enemy on the head to deal heavy damage.
潘重击目标头部，对目标造成300% + 40% ATK伤害；处于“苍竹劲”状态时本技能还会造成目标当前生命值12%的额外伤害，额外伤害不会超过自身240% ATK。

Pang strikes an enemy on the head, dealing 300% + 40% ATK damage. If he is in Unyielding Force stance, this strike deals extra damage equal to 12% of the enemy's current HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 240% ATK.
伤害提高至320% + 40% ATK，处于“苍竹劲”状态下造成的额外伤害提高至目标当前生命值的13%，最高不会超过自身260% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to 320% + 40% ATK, and the extra damage dealt in Unyielding Force stance to 13% of the enemy's current HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 260% ATK.
伤害提高至340% + 40% ATK，处于“苍竹劲”状态下造成的额外伤害提高至目标当前生命值的14%，最高不会超过自身280% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to 340% + 40% ATK, and the extra damage dealt in Unyielding Force stance to 14% of the enemy's current HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 280% ATK.
伤害提高至360% + 40% ATK，处于“苍竹劲”状态下造成的额外伤害提高至目标当前生命值的15%，最高不会超过自身300% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to 360% + 40% ATK, and the extra damage dealt in Unyielding Force stance to 15% of the enemy's current HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 300% ATK.
为自己施加护盾，在护盾持续时间内获得霸体，在护盾结束、被打破或叠加时对敌人造成伤害。
Pang gains a shield and remains unaffected while the shield is active. He deals damage to an enemy when the shield expires, breaks, or is reapplied.
主动释放时蓄力，之后获得一个340% + 40% ATK的苍竹护盾持续9秒，苍竹护盾存在时提供霸体效果。当苍竹护盾消失、被打破或与已有的苍竹护盾叠加时，将幻化成绿叶飞向当前攻击的目标，对其造成潘210% + 30% ATK的伤害；蓄力过程中潘处于霸体状态。

Active. Pang channels his chi, gaining a 340% + 40% ATK Chi Barrier for 9s. While the barrier is active, Pang remains unaffected.
When the barrier expires, breaks, or is reapplied, it transforms into razor leaves that deal 210% + 30% ATK damage to Pang's current target. Pang is also unaffected while channeling his chi.
获得的护盾量提升至380% + 40% ATK，绿叶造成的伤害提升至230% + 30% ATK。
Increases the Chi Barrier's shield value to 380% + 40% ATK and the razor leaves damage to 230% + 30% ATK.
获得的护盾量提升至420% + 40% ATK，绿叶造成的伤害提升至250% + 30% ATK。
Increases the Chi Barrier's shield value to 420% + 40% ATK and the razor leaves damage to 250% + 30% ATK.
获得的护盾量提升至460% + 40% ATK，绿叶造成的伤害提升至270% + 30% ATK。
Increases the Chi Barrier's shield value to 460% + 40% ATK and the razor leaves damage to 270% + 30% ATK.
战斗中，自身攻击力提升9%，“苍竹劲”状态期间额外提升6%攻击力。
Pang increases his ATK by 9% during battle. He further increases his ATK by an extra 6% while in Unyielding Force stance.
战斗中，自身攻击力提升12%，“苍竹劲”状态期间额外提升8%攻击力。
Pang increases his ATK by 12% during battle. He further increases his ATK by an extra 8% while in Unyielding Force stance.
战斗中，自身攻击力提升15%，“苍竹劲”状态期间额外提升10%攻击力。
Pang increases his ATK by 15% during battle. He further increases his ATK by an extra 10% while in Unyielding Force stance.
苍竹护盾生效期间额外提供攻击力加成。
Pang increases the ATK of any unit shielded by his Chi Barrier.
苍竹护盾存在期间，其携带者的攻击力提升15%。
Pang increases the ATK of any unit shielded by his Chi Barrier by 15%.
苍竹护盾存在期间，其携带者的攻击力提升17%。
Pang increases the ATK of any unit shielded by his Chi Barrier by 17%.
潘能感知场上的“真气”并在适当时候支援场上的友方英雄，每当自身以外的友方英雄能量到达850及以上时，使其获得苍竹护盾，该效果对同一名角色每15秒最多触发一次。

Pang draws on the chi around him to protect an ally. When an allied hero (other than Pang) reaches 850 Energy or higher, Pang grants them a Chi Barrier. He can only shield the same ally once every 15s.
苍竹护盾存在期间，其携带者的攻击力提升19%。
Pang increases the ATK of any unit shielded by his Chi Barrier by 19%.
“苍竹劲”状态时获得额外防御穿透；进入“苍竹劲”状态后立刻获得苍竹护盾。
Pang immediately gains a Chi Barrier upon entering the Unyielding Force stance. While in this stance, he gains extra DEF Penetration.
处于“苍竹劲”状态时获得30点防御穿透；进入“苍竹劲”状态后立刻获得苍竹护盾。
Pang immediately gains a Chi Barrier upon entering the Unyielding Force stance. While in this stance, he gains 30 DEF Penetration.
